If a mobject was fixed in frame by passing it throughadd_fixed_in_frame_mobjects(), then this undoes that fixing.
The Mobject will no longer be fixed in frame.

method_signatures.name: remove_fixed_orientation_mobjects
method_signatures.description:
If a mobject was fixed in its orientation by passing it throughadd_fixed_orientation_mobjects(), then this undoes that fixing.
The Mobject will no longer have a fixed orientation.

method_signatures.name: reset_rotation_matrix
method_signatures.description:
Sets the value of self.rotation_matrix to
the matrix corresponding to the current position of the camera

method_signatures.name: set_focal_distance
method_signatures.description: Sets the focal_distance of the Camera.

method_signatures.name: set_gamma
method_signatures.description: Sets the angle of rotation of the camera about the vector from the ORIGIN to the Camera.

method_signatures.name: set_phi
method_signatures.description: Sets the polar angle i.e the angle between Z_AXIS and Camera through ORIGIN in radians.

method_signatures.name: set_theta
method_signatures.description: Sets the azimuthal angle i.e the angle that spins the camera around Z_AXIS in radians.

method_signatures.name: set_zoom
method_signatures.description: Sets the zoom amount of the camera.
